messages:
Sam (CS): Heads-up — NimbleRetail asked for a 'quota shadow replay' + autoscale sprint for their Dedicated pool. Target window: Tue 09:00 PT. Need SRE + runtime eng to validate autoscale thresholds, and CS to run the replay trace.
Priya (SRE): I can be there. What are the exact objectives? Smoke latency, ensure no OOMs, and test scale-to-zero backoff?
Sam (CS): Objectives: 1) Verify reserved quota holds at 80% sustained QPS for 30m, 2) validate autoscale from min=2 -> max=18 GPUs under synthetic surge, 3) confirm fallback to smaller model variant if capacity hits cap, 4) capture any request-level error patterns for renewal risk.
Diego (Runtime Eng): Sounds good. We should prime KV caches before the replay. Also want to enable per-route tracing for the 1st 5 minutes. Can we run a shadow replay with real traffic traces but at 50% RPS?
Kelsey (Customer PM): We can provide a 3-hour trace of user sessions. Prefer replay at 40/60/100% cadence to see progressive impact. Also we want a short failover to their fallback model at 100% to validate correctness.
Priya (SRE): Plan: ramp steps: 0->40% (10m), 40->60% (10m), 60->100% (15m), soak 30m at 100% then drain. We'll monitor 95th/99th latencies, GPU mem, and request error rate.
Diego (Runtime Eng): Autoscale params I'll use for the run: cpu_target=65%, token_throughput_target=1.2M/min, scale_up_cooldown=90s, scale_down_cooldown=600s, max_workers=18, min_workers=2. If we've got backup model (quantized-variant-v2) configured, we can set routing fallback policy: fallback_on_capacity=true.
Sam (CS): Quick check — what quota number to reserve for the replay? NimbleRetail committed 1.5M tokens/min peak; we should reserve 1.2M for the test to leave buffer.
Priya (SRE): I'll set the pool quota to 1.25M tokens/min and enable a soft-limit alert at 1.0M. If we see sustained >1.18M for 5m, that's a trigger to throttle or failover.
Max (Support): I'll prepare the runbook snippet to post to the customer channel. Also adding an escalation line to EngOnCall if request error rate >1%.
Diego (Runtime Eng): Load generator invocation (we'll use our trace-replay tool):
```
python tools/trace_replay.py --trace nimble_march_dump.json --rate-scale 1.0 --threads 40 --warmup 300 --headers 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
```
Run at rate-scale 0.4/0.6/1.0 for the ramp. Use --kv-prime to hit prefix cache before recording metrics.
Kelsey (Customer PM): For the fallback validation, please confirm outputs match within acceptable delta. We'll run evals on a sample of 200 responses post-failover. I can coordinate product folks to review.
Priya (SRE): We'll tag the run in metrics: cluster=nimble-dedicated, test=shadow-replay-2026-03-25, and create dashboards for GPU_util, model_latency_p95, error_rate.
Diego (Runtime Eng): One caveat: if we hit OOM on quantized-variant-v2 under 100% RPS, fallback may cascade latencies. I propose we enable a circuit-breaker: if fallback latency_p95 > 1.2x baseline, stop routing to fallback and queue requests to hosted fallback route.
Sam (CS): Noted. Also want to capture qualitative feedback from Nimble: are any API patterns spiking (large context sizes, soft timeouts) — that'll go into the renewal health pack.
Kelsey (Customer PM): We'll collect CSAT notes during run and confirm renewal owner sees the metrics within 24h.
autoscale-bot: Scheduled job created: shadow-replay-nimble-3265432100 at 2026-03-25T16:00:00Z. Notifying predicates: SRE, Runtime Eng, CS.
Max (Support): I'll be the thread owner for incident comms. Will post the pre-run checklist 1h prior and then live updates every 5m during the soak.
Priya (SRE): Pre-run checklist highlights: confirm pool quota 1.25M, KV prime job succeeded, tracer enabled, alert hooks to #eng-oncall, burnout detection alarm enabled.
Diego (Runtime Eng): After the run, I'll pull a perf snapshot and include kernel selection logs + memory histogram. Sam, please collect customer notes and any example erroneous requests for eval.
Sam (CS): Agreed. Anything else?
Kelsey (Customer PM): One more ask — can we record a short Loom of the dashboard for execs? 3–4 min highlight reel of key graphs.
Priya (SRE): Yep. I'll capture Grafana snapshot and export.
Sam (CS): Great — meeting invite to follow. Thanks team :thumbsup:
